content:
Alex M: I opened PR #4823 for the upcoming release notes + migration guide covering the model catalog changes. Need docs review + merge during tomorrow's release window (09:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4823

Samira Patel: taking this. Quick heads-up — preview build failed: looks like frontmatter is missing on migration.md and the SDK example still references 'gpt-small' which is deprecated. I'll push fixes tonight.

CI Bot: Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4823--redwood-docs.netlify.app — Status: build failed (exit code 1)
Logs: Error: Missing frontmatter 'release_note' in content/migration.md

Ben Cole: can we keep the changelog entry a short, copy-pasteable one-liner for ops? Also include explicit upgrade steps in the migration guide.

Samira Patel: yes — I'll add a concise changelog line and a tiny migration snippet. Plan to replace the old model id with the recommended one and show a minimal SDK example + note about tokenization differences.

Samira Patel: proposed SDK snippet (will include in migration.md):
```python
# Python SDK: switch from redwood/gpt-small -> redwood/roadmap-llm
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="{{REDWOOD_API_KEY}}")
resp = client.text.generate(model="redwood/roadmap-llm", input="Summarize quarterly metrics")
print(resp.output_text)
```
Note: recommend pinning quantization for parity in perf: quantize='q4_0' in examples where applicable.

DocsBot: label 'release-note-required' added. Also added labels: 'migration', 'breaking-change'.

Alex M: timeline check — we need this merged by 08:30 PT tomorrow to give infra time for smoke tests. If CI doesn't pass, we need a reviewer-approved manual merge plan. @Samira can you push the frontmatter + snippet tonight?

Samira Patel: yep, pushing commit with frontmatter and corrected snippet before EOD. Tagging @Marco Li for localization coordination.

Marco Li: I'll queue localization once preview is green. If the build stays flaky overnight, we'll skip translations for the first rollout and follow up.

CI Bot: New build triggered (commit 5f2b1d). Preview: https://deploy-preview-4823--redwood-docs.netlify.app — Status: success ✅

Ben Cole: LGTM from me, left a tiny wording nit in the PR comments. @Alex M if Samira merged the fix and CI stays green, do you want me to merge at 08:45 PT?

Alex M: yes please — plan: squash-merge after CI green + one reviewer approval. Merge target 08:45 PT, so ops can run smoke tests before 09:00 PT release. Include the one-line changelog in the merge message.

Samira Patel: merged the fix and added the migration snippet + changelog one-liner. PTAL, thanks all :rocket:

CI Bot: Merge checks: approvals satisfied, CI passed. Branch mergeable.

Ben Cole: merging on my side at scheduled time unless anything blocks.

Marco Li: noted for localization — will start string extraction after the merge completes.

Alex M: thanks team, closing this thread once merged.
